keyFindings.description: walk's doc comment states a looser contract than the new walk keeps: it forbids changing Text or Children of nodes not yet visited, but after visit walkNode reads the visited node's Type and Children against sizes measured before the walk (walk.go:54, 62-67), and a Type change on any unvisited node changes whether it is descended. A visitor that does either gets wrong pos/end or an index panic, where the old walk measured as it went. Say a visitor must not change any node's Type, Text or Children, the visited node included.

referenceIsLeafNodeType copies isLeafNodeType's case list, which this PR does not change: it pins the schema's source list, so a later correct leaf-type addition fails TestWalkVisitsEveryNodeWithTodaysRange while walk is right. Use isLeafNodeType in referenceWalkNode, referenceNodeSize and markedReadBack; the frozen reference pins the walk algorithm and len16 (referenceLen16), which is what this PR changed.
